boundary: IEC supplies the water injection skid inlet flange (skid with high-pressure pumps by IEC); EPC supplies counter-flange, gasket, bolts and the demin water forwarding pumps.
isolation: EPC manual isolation valve and spectacle blind; IEC skid inlet valve.
operating_conditions: Water/fuel ratio 0.60 on LDO (TQ-IEC-018). HMB stream 28 is at the IEC skid discharge (60 bar(a)); pressure at IF-03 is 3.0-6.0 barg.
protection: EPC demin forwarding pumps shut-off head <= 12 barg (< 16 barg design).
remarks: HMB pressure check not applicable: PER-003 stream 28 is downstream of the IEC injection pumps (TQ-IEC-021 item 3); the injection pump power is part of the IEC GT auxiliaries.
